title: The screenshot prompt is hard to focus and lets input through to the pane
body:
The screenshot tool (d73fd69) asks the person by drawing a prompt over the pane named in the call (`src/server/chrome/prompt.rs`). The prompt answers `y`, `a`, `n` and Escape only while that pane has keyboard focus, and only 500 ms after it appears. Jack found it nearly unusable on a live server. He could not focus it, and input that missed it went to the program in the pane: vim switched to visual mode while he answered.

## Proposal

- The prompt is a modal dialog in the centre of the decade window, with everything else dimmed behind it.
- While it is up, every key and click goes to the dialog, and nothing reaches a pane, the sidebar or decade's keybinds. It closes only on an answer: allow once (`y`), allow and turn the mode on (`a`), deny (`n` or Escape), or the 30-second timeout, which denies.
- The dialog names the agent, the workspace and the pane, and the pane's outline pulses behind the dim layer.
- It shows on whatever workspace the viewer has up. decade does not switch workspaces for it.
- Keys pressed in its first 500 ms are ignored.
- Every viewer shows the dialog, and the first answer counts.
close_reason: Landed in b77a951: a centred modal dialog that takes all presses and keys until answered. Its buttons have no hover highlight yet.
